indexes._comment: GET /api/bookings/mine — the rider's booking list, and the ONLY place a rider can read their boarding OTP. Without this index the query throws FAILED_PRECONDITION, the route 500s, and no driver can ever verify boarding (so every trip settles as a no-show at 5%).
POST /api/rides/search — the candidate scan. Without this index no rider can find any ride at all.
